Subject: Portal onboarding — MSA redline & signer authority questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at StellarMed is ready to move forward with portal enrollment, but our procurement/legal folks flagged two items that will affect activation in Ariba: the MSA redline (we added a small carveout for telemetry retention) and the signer mapping on the Order Form (we have two finance entities).

Quick asks so we can finish our pre-auth checklist:
- Can Redwood accept a dual-signature flow on the order form (entity A signs for subscription, entity B signs for invoicing)?
- Will the portal support separate remit-to / billing contact fields so our AP system can reconcile PO vs invoice?
- I attached the MSA redline and a quick fields matrix. If helpful, we can execute an interim DocuSign to unblock registration.

Lucia
Lucia Mendez

StellarMed

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — MSA redline & signer authority questions

Hi Lucia — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the docs. I looped in Jonas (AE) and our legal ops lead so we can answer precisely.

High-level: we support separate remit/billing fields in both Ariba and Coupa activations and the portal can map PO->invoice remit via GL code or remit-to ID. Dual-signature scenarios are common; we typically request the Order Form include an explicit signing matrix and we run a quick e-sign workflow to capture both signatures before provisioning. That said, any liability carveouts in the MSA need legal review.

Next step: Jonas, can you confirm the expected entities (names and tax IDs) and whether StellarMed wants the dual-signature as simultaneous DocuSign or sequential?

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — MSA redline & signer authority questions

Hi all — I reviewed the MSA redline and the carveout Lucia mentions is narrowly scoped to telemetry retention beyond operational logs; legal is comfortable with accepting it if StellarMed signs the attached limited addendum that: (1) clarifies retention window (60 days), and (2) limits telemetry to anonymized metrics only.

On the process: best practice is to finalize the Order Form fields in the portal (so the activation ticket contains the exact PO->invoice mapping), then send the DocuSign envelope that references the portal Order Form version number in the signature block. That ensures the provisioning and SSO->PO handoff use the correct field mapping.

For dual-signature: we can support simultaneous DocuSign recipients. Please provide the two entity names and the signer roles (name, email, title) and we will generate the envelope.

I've attached a short addendum template and a one-page activation checklist for Ariba/Coupa enrollments.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Portal_Activation_Checklist.pdf, Limited_Retention_Addendum_template.docx
